text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's performance in the
Sprinters
Stakes has left a lasting
impression in the minds
of many viewers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that hope in mind, I get to work
drafting
another email requesting that
Aston Machan be
made an official
mascot.
choice_data_list: （公式マスコット化の後押しになれば……）
choice_data_list_en: (If this helps boost their chances of becoming an official mascot...)

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And here's your gift! Thank you for your

continued efforts! Go ahead, take it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With no idea as to what's going on, I'm
handed
some beautifully wrapped
chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It's simple! This year, Tazuna and I are
handing
out chocolate to all members of
staff as a sign of
our appreciation!
choice_data_list: きゅ、急にどうしたんですか？
choice_data_list_en: Wh-What's gotten into you so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Especially for you! I know you've been
working
with Aston Machan, so I'm sure
your hands are
very full!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Not only have you been working hard on
the daily
in preparation for races, but
you've also worked
hard to put Aston
Machan in the spotlight!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The bronze statue may have been
rejected, but
you've been updating that
four-panel comic blog,
distributing
handmade dolls, and going around
the
shopping district in a Machan suit!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I truly admire your rare and remarkable

dedication to Aston Machan! And I hope
you'll
continue to support her in the
future!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Well, if you'll excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Director Akikawa whirls off like a
hurricane. While
I'm pleased to have
received such praise and
appreciation...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might be a nice idea to find some
chocolates of
my own for Aston Machan.
But just as this
thought occurs to me...
choice_data_list: 今日、バレンタインだったんだ……

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Whimper...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan shows up on the verge of
tears.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I got less chocolate from my friends than
last
Valentine's Day...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone forgets about me until they
see me
standing there.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
One person ran out of chocolates just
before they
got to me, and another said
she'd just have to
bring me some
chocolate tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I guess I've just got no presence at all... Sniff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's shoulders slump. I open
my
mouth to suggest that we go out and
buy some of
her favorite chocolates, but
before I can say
anything...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make my presence stronger.
And to
do that, I need people to see
me—to see Aston
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: So... let's make Machan chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Well, that plan works!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to use this chocolate pen to
draw my
face on the white chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Eeeeasy does it...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh. My face went off the side. This is
harder
than I thought...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We swiftly rustle up a whole heap of
Aston
Machan chocolates, and then...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello there. My name's Aston Machan.
Have a
great day!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's all this about?
choice_data_list: よろしくお願いしま～す
choice_data_list_en: Looking forward to working with ya~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Who knows...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We hand them out at the academy
gates.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I think that's just about all of
them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they'll remember me now. I
should have a
solid supply of chocolate
next Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Well, Air Groove will probably show
up soon.
We should really make a move.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We got some weird looks, but she seems
happy
with how things went, so I'd say it
was a success.
As we prepare to head
back...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right.
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid there's only this one Machan
chocolate
left, but still.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I want you to have it. Thank you for your
time
today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. I wonder if you'll be able to
bring yourself
to eat it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take the Aston Machan chocolate
home, being
careful not to damage it on
the way.
choice_data_list: それは……そうかもしれない

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I was so sad about everyone forgetting
me, I
almost forgot to give you these.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The chocolates are carefully wrapped. It
looks
like a lot of effort went into
preparing them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...So, I've actually hidden a surprise in
there.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You'll find out what it is when you
eat them.
Enjoy them in your office,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's Machan's special surprise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later that evening, after returning to my
office, I
pop one of the chocolates into
my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's soft and sweet milk chocolate with
caramel in
the center.
